## Deprecated

This repository is slated for archival. We recommend switching to [Atmos Custom Commands](https://atmos.tools/cli/configuration/commands?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=cloudposse/build-harness&utm_content=deprecation-notice) and [Atmos Workflows](https://atmos.tools/workflows?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=cloudposse/build-harness&utm_content=deprecation-notice) instead.

The exact sunset date has not been determined yet.

We literally have <a href="https://cpco.io/terraform-modules?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=cloudposse/build-harness&utm_content=terraform_modules">*hundreds of other terraform modules*</a> that are Open Source and well-maintained. Check them out!


### Historical Description

This build-harness is a collection of Makefiles to facilitate building READMEs, Golang projects, Dockerfiles, Helm charts, and more.
